scene.ko: 땅콩 알레르기를 미리 알리고, 땅콩이 올라간 음식이 잘못 나오자 침착하게 바로잡는다.

lines.en: Before I order, I should mention that I'm allergic to peanuts. Is the curry safe for me?
lines.ko: 주문하기 전에 말씀드릴 게 있는데요, 제가 땅콩 알레르기가 있어요. 카레는 먹어도 괜찮을까요?
alt: Before I order, I have a peanut allergy. Is the curry okay for me?

lines.en: Let me check with the kitchen... The curry has peanut sauce, but the chef can make it without.
lines.ko: 주방에 확인해 볼게요... 카레에 땅콩 소스가 들어가는데, 셰프가 빼고 만들 수 있대요.

lines.en: That would be great. Could you also make sure it isn't cooked in the same pan?
lines.ko: 그럼 좋겠어요. 같은 팬에서 요리하지 않도록 해 주실 수 있나요?
alt: Great. And please make sure they don't use the same pan.

lines.en: Absolutely. I'll let them know it's a serious allergy.
Excuse me. I think there's been a mistake. This looks like it has peanuts on top.
lines.ko: 저기요. 착오가 있는 것 같아요. 위에 땅콩이 올라가 있는 것 같은데요.
alt: Excuse me. I think this is wrong. There are peanuts on top.

lines.en: Oh, I'm so sorry! That must be another table's order. Please don't eat it.
lines.ko: 어머, 정말 죄송합니다! 다른 테이블 주문인가 봐요. 드시지 마세요.

lines.en: Don't worry, I haven't touched it. How long will the right one take?
lines.ko: 걱정 마세요, 손 안 댔어요. 제 음식은 얼마나 걸릴까요?
alt: It's okay, I didn't eat any. How long will mine take?

lines.en: About ten minutes. I'll make sure it comes out right this time, and your drinks are on the house.
lines.ko: 10분쯤이요. 이번에는 꼭 제대로 나오게 할게요. 음료는 무료로 드리겠습니다.

lines.en: Thanks for taking it seriously. I appreciate it.
alt: Thank you for being so careful. I appreciate it.

expressions.en: I think there's been a mistake.
